root_cause.text: The wbrf_record() function fails to free the tmp buffer allocated via kcalloc() when acpi_evaluate_dsm() returns NULL, resulting in a memory leak in the error path.
root_cause.evidence: The patch shows that the tmp buffer is allocated earlier in the function via kcalloc(), but the error handling path following acpi_evaluate_dsm() (when `!obj` is true) was missing a kfree(tmp) call before returning -EINVAL. The fix explicitly adds `kfree(tmp);` in the error handling block to ensure the allocated memory is freed regardless of whether acpi_evaluate_dsm() succeeds or fails.
